skills.name: Kamehameha
skills.description: A powerful energy wave attack that can cause massive damage to opponents.

skills.name: Meteor Combination
skills.description: A powerful attack that combines multiple meteors to strike the opponent.

skills.name: Solar Flare
skills.description: A blinding light attack that can temporarily disable opponents.

skills.name: Kaioken
skills.description: A technique that temporarily increases the user's all stats by 100% during 2 turns.
skills.nerf: Reduces 40% the user's defense and stamina when it ends.

skills.name: Ki wave
skills.description: A simple energy wave that causes damage to enemies

skills.name: Meteor Crash
skills.description: A simple attack combo that causes physical damage

skills.name: Full Power Energy Blast Volley
skills.description: Launches dozens of small, fast energy blasts back-to-back. Affects all enemies

skills.name: Meteor Strike
skills.description: Does a simple kick at high speed to all enemies

skills.name: Magic Barrier
skills.description: Creates a Magical Barrier to damage enemies. It can be used to null enemy's ki attacks only if yor Magic is stronger than your enemy's Attack+Special

skills.name: Telekinesis
skills.description: Inmovilizes the rival, preventing them to attack the next turn

ultimate_skills.name: Spirit Bomb
ultimate_skills.description: A massive energy attack that gathers energy from all living beings to create a powerful bomb. The default cost can be reduced by 10 points for every ally in the team.

ultimate_skills.name: Super Kamehameha
ultimate_skills.description: An enhanced version of the Kamehameha that deals even more damage to opponents.

ultimate_skills.name: Final Flash
ultimate_skills.description: A devastating energy beam attack that can obliterate opponents. Power increases by 20 points every turn you charge it, up to a maximum of 200 points.
ultimate_skills.nerf: If you choose to charge the attack, you will not attack during that turn, leaving you vulnerable to enemy attacks.

ultimate_skills.name: Victory Rush
ultimate_skills.description: Instantly close in on your enemy and launch a powerful rush attack

ultimate_skills.name: Katchin cube summon
ultimate_skills.description: Summons a giant cube made of the strongest material ever existed, then throw it to the enemy
